answer: Bonded vouching: a new identity is admitted only if three established members each lock 50 POA for 60 epochs as vouchers. If the newcomer is later flagged as a sybil, every voucher loses half the bond, so each extra fake identity needs fresh vouchers whose total risk grows with the glacier of prior flags. Vouchers may back only one newcomer per epoch, so the spiral of cost rises with scale. A sudden gale of joins from one funding cluster is detected by graph audit and slashed on-chain.
